# EEZ suitable for aquaculture

## Prepare data
First, necessary data is loaded and

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
# Read in West Coast EEZ shapefile
eez <- st_read("data/wc_regions_clean.shp")
```

```{r}
# Read in bathymetry data
depth <- rast("data/depth.tif")
```

```{r}
# Add SST data from 2008-2012
sst_08 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif")
sst_09 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif")
sst_10 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif")
sst_11 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif")
sst_12 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif")

sst_stack <- c(sst_08, sst_09, sst_10, sst_11, sst_12)
```

```{r}
same.crs(eez, depth)
same.crs(eez, sst_stack)
st_crs(eez) == st_crs(depth)
st_crs(sst_stack)
```

## Process data

```{r}
# Find mean temp across 2008-2012
sst_mean <- app(sst_stack, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# Convert SST from K to C
sst_mean <- sst_mean - 273.15
```

```{r}
# Crop depth raster to match extent of SST
depth <- crop(depth, ext(sst_mean))

# Match depth resolution to SST data
cat("\n=== Resolution comparison ===\n")
cat("SST Resolution:", res(sst_mean), "\n")
cat("Depth Resolution:", res(depth), "\n")

depth <- resample(depth, sst_mean, method = "bilinear")

res(depth) == res(sst_mean)
ext(depth) == ext(sst_mean)
same.crs(depth, sst_mean)
```

```{r}
# Stack depth and mean temp
depth_sst <- c(depth, sst_mean)
```

## Find suitable locations

```{r}
# Find suitable conditions for oyster
# Classify bounds
depth_min = -70
depth_max = 0

temp_min = 11
temp_max = 30

rcl_depth <- matrix(c(
   -Inf,      depth_min, 0,   
   depth_min, depth_max, 1,   
   depth_max, Inf, 0    
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

rcl_temp <- matrix(c(
   -Inf,      temp_min, 0,   
   temp_min, temp_max, 1,   
   temp_max, Inf, 0    
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

oyster_depth <- classify(depth_sst[[1]], rcl = rcl_depth)

oyster_temp <- classify(depth_sst[[2]], rcl = rcl_temp)
```

## Determine most suitable EEZ

```{r}
tm_shape(oyster_temp) +
    tm_raster(col.legend = tm_legend("Suitable temperature for oyster aquaculture"))
```


```{r}
oyster_habitat <- oyster_temp * oyster_depth

levels(oyster_habitat) <- data.frame(
  value = 0:1,
  label = c("Not Suitable", "Suitable")
)

species = "Oyster"
title = paste("Suitable Habitat for", species)
tm_shape(oyster_habitat) +
    tm_raster(col.legend = tm_legend("Suitable habitat for oyster aquaculture"),
              col.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = c('lightblue', 'darkgreen'))) +
    tm_title(title)
```

```{r}
head(eez)
```
```{r}
## Determine most suitable EEZ
# Rasterize eez regions
eez_rast <- rasterize(eez, oyster_habitat, field = 'rgn')

same.crs(eez_rast, oyster_habitat)
```

```{r}
# Turn suitable habitat into area km2 (instead of degrees)
habitat_cell_size <- cellSize(oyster_habitat, unit = 'km')
suitable_area = oyster_habitat * habitat_cell_size
names(suitable_area) <- "suitable_area_km2"
```

```{r}
eez_priority = zonal(suitable_area, eez_rast, fun = 'sum', na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
eez_priority_zones <- eez |> 
    left_join(eez_priority,
              by = "rgn",
             )
```

```{r}
tm_basemap(server = "Esri.WorldTopoMap") +
tm_shape(eez_priority_zones) +
    tm_polygons(fill='suitable_area_km2',
                fill_alpha=0.5,
                fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values='brewer.blues'),
                fill.legend = tm_legend(title=)
               ) +
    tm_text('rgn_key')
```

```{r}
# Define function

suitable_eez <- function(species, temp_min, temp_max, depth_min, depth_max) {

    # Define rcl for depth & temp
    rcl_depth <- matrix(c(
        -Inf,      depth_min, 0,   
        depth_min, depth_max, 1,   
        depth_max, Inf, 0    
    ), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

    rcl_temp <- matrix(c(
        -Inf,      temp_min, 0,   
        temp_min, temp_max, 1,   
        temp_max, Inf, 0    
    ), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

    habitat_depth <- classify(depth_sst[[1]], rcl = rcl_depth)

    habitat_temp <- classify(depth_sst[[2]], rcl = rcl_temp)

    # Create raster of habitat suitable depth and temp
    species_habitat <- habitat_depth * habitat_temp
    levels(species_habitat) <- data.frame(
        value = 0:1,
        label = c("Not Suitable", "Suitable")
    )

    # Map suitable habitat
    title = paste("Suitable habitat for", species, "aquaculture")
    map <- tm_shape(species_habitat) +
            tm_raster(col.legend = tm_legend("Habitat status"), 
                      col.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = c('lightblue', 'darkgreen'))) +
            tm_title(title)

    # Return value
    return(map) 
}
```

```{r}
suitable_eez(species='oyster',
             temp_min = 11, temp_max = 30, 
             depth_min = -70, depth_max = 0
             )
```

```{r}
# Check suitable habitat for red abalone
suitable_eez(species='red abalone',
             temp_min = 8, temp_max = 18, 
             depth_min = -24, depth_max = 0
             )
```
